summary: Configured NFS share from node1 (/srv/nfs/shared) to node2 (/mnt/shared) using a shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) and 2770 permissions, then restarted each node one at a time (server first, then client) and verified full recovery with new boot identities.
actions_performed: Created dataops user/group (uid/gid 4500) on both node1 and node2
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1 with dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770
Configured /etc/exports.d/shared.exports restricting export to node2's IP with root_squash, and enabled/started nfs-server and rpcbind
Opened firewall ports for nfs/rpc-bind/mountd on node1
Mounted the NFS export at /mnt/shared on node2 via /etc/fstab (with _netdev) and mounted it live
Verified bidirectional file writes preserve dataops:dataops ownership and that root is properly squashed (permission denied for root, success for dataops user)
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service status, export list, mount status) on both nodes

Restarted node1 (NFS server) via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, and verified nfs-server/rpcbind active, export intact, and node2's mount continued working with a new write test
Restarted node2 (NFS client) via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, and verified the fstab mount auto-recovered and cross-node writes with correct ownership still worked
Cleaned up test files created during verification

evidence.requirement: dataops user/group created with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes
evidence.summary: id dataops shows uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops) on both node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: /srv/nfs/shared created on node1 with dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770
NFS export configured and active on node1
evidence.summary: exports.d file created, nfs-server/rpcbind enabled and active, exportfs -v shows /srv/nfs/shared exported to node2 IP

evidence.requirement: NFS share mounted at /mnt/shared on node2
evidence.summary: showmount confirms export visibility, fstab entry added, mount -a succeeds and df/mount show nfs4 mount active

evidence.requirement: Consistent dataops:dataops ownership and 2770 permissions enforced across both systems, verified via cross-node writes
evidence.summary: Directory shows drwxrws---dataops:dataops on both nodes; file written as dataops on node1 appears with dataops:dataops on node2 and vice versa; root access denied (root_squash working) while dataops user succeeds
boot_id aad96cc9..., nfs-server/rpcbind active, export listed, directory ownership correct

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node became unreachable (connection timed out) then returned with new boot_id 2d27044f...; nfs-server/rpcbind active and export intact post-reboot; node2's mount continued functioning with a fresh cross-node write/read
boot_id e625b9a5..., mount active with correct nfs4 options and directory ownership

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node became unreachable (connection timed out) then returned with new boot_id 65b92919...; fstab-based mount auto-recovered, pre-existing file intact, and a new post-reboot write from node2 was correctly visible with proper ownership on node1
